title: Topic 22 政治
japanese_text:
A：最近の野党についてどう思う？
B：なんか<u>余計な</u>ことばかり話してない？<u>不景気</u>で<u>所得</u>が減って、生活の<u>質</u>が下がっているんだから、解決策を考えてほしいな。
english_translation:
A: What do you think about the opposition parties these days?
B: Everything they're saying is so redundant, isn't it? I wish they'd come up with solutions to this recession, decreasing incomes, and decreasing quality of life.
